Reason: The CT image (Figure 3) demonstrates a well-defined, homogeneous soft-tissue density mass in the right paratracheal region that abuts but does not compress or invade the adjacent trachea. This smooth, non-aggressive appearance adjacent to the major airways is characteristic of a benign foregut duplication cyst, such as a bronchogenic cyst.
